revoked_artifacts.reason: Runtime-invalid build: ADF7021 14.7456 MHz TCXO was incorrectly passed as the STM32 HSE OSC value. 0B-P3 readback matched this artifact exactly but the application produced no GET_VERSION. Automatic exact-stock recovery passed.

targets.notes: Normal product flash operations remain disabled. 0B-P2 remains physically qualified: 131072-byte main-flash geometry, two byte-identical reads, and stock SHA256 4981b35b2d50ada0b09322d9de19dd58a0cbd49eb005693499d1acae92f9d684. The first 0B-P3 attempt safely failed using the revoked clock-misconfigured P1 artifact and automatic exact-stock recovery passed. Corrected 0B-P1R1 is qualified at SHA256 b7ec163fc3a3cec395c0e3e3065f20c6dc6be186e32ccdcf9044c85ec681b9b8 using STM32 HSE 8 MHz, ADF7021 TCXO 14.7456 MHz, and no OSC override. 0B-P3 attempt 2 physically qualified the corrected artifact: exact programmed readback matched, exact YWD-1278 GET_VERSION identity passed, the exact protected 131072-byte stock image was restored and read back to the qualified stock SHA, and exact stock GET_VERSION passed. The qualification-only write gate is closed again after qualification; normal product flash_enabled remains false. The GPIO helper's FLASH_WRITTEN=NO marker refers only to the helper itself; the P3 qualification intentionally performed controlled STM32 main-flash writes through stm32flash. GPIO20=BOOT0 and GPIO21=RESET remain physically qualified. Option-byte writes are forbidden.
